title: Wire MiniMax H3 fl2va as a model
description: Ship MiniMax H3 in Cubric Vision. Engine bumped 0.29.2 -> 0.30.0 and the workflow template/runtime split is done (generate_h3.py + registry). Remaining: dep entries pointed at the publisher's own repos (NEVER re-hosted on R2 - the licence forbids redistribution), models.js ModelDef 'minimax-h3', progressStages, type-consumer sweep. H3 emits video AND native stereo audio from one sampler pass as a packed NestedTensor, so the LTX audio I/O in docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md is the prior art. The licence gate is MPI-451, running in a parallel session - its licences.js already carries a 'minimax-h3' entry, which fixes this model's id. ref2va is a SEPARATE ModelDef (minimax-h3-ref2va). Feasibility numbers and the weight matrix live on MPI-449.
acceptance: MPI-451 has landed and H3 carries a licence descriptor - this card cannot start before that
Engine bumped off 0.29.2 with the custom-node pairing check run first, per .claude/rules/comfy_engine.md
H3 weights download from the publisher's own repository - nothing re-hosted on R2
A working op produces video AND its audio track in the app, not just on the bench
The licence text ships and is reachable in-app, with the required NOTICE string and attribution
Written confirmation on whether the authorization extends to end users in excluded territories, or the gate carries the user's own authorization route
